I thought your organization meant you wouldn't be up for something like this, but you just made it a million times better. This was the most fun I've had in ages, and it's all thanks to your… organized spontaneity."

Maya laughs. "See? Being prepared doesn't mean you can't have fun. It just means you can have *more* fun, with less stress."
